data.name: Aaymenun
data.gender_notes: Aaymenun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who supports and maintains the faith of Muslims. The name Aaymenun carries the meaning “Support of the faithful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aaymenun usually hope their child will grow to embody support of the faithful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaymenun is a name with deep spiritual meaning, representing the idea of providing support and aid to others. It is a name that inspires kindness, generosity, and a strong sense of duty towards others.
data.etymology: Aaymenun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Support of the faithful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaymenun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: آيمنون
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم آيمنون مشتق من الجذر العربي 'أمن' الذي يعني الأمان والسلام. في القرآن الكريم، يُذكر الأمان والسلام كمنح الله تعالى لعباده المؤمنين. اسم آيمنون يرمز إلى المباركين والمؤمنين الذين ينعمون بالأمان والسلام الإلهي.

in_urdu.name: آئیمنون
in_urdu.meaning: آئیمنون کا مطلب مبارک اور محفوظ ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: آئیمنون نام عربی جڑ 'أمن' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حفاظت اور سلامتی۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام ان مبارک اور محفوظ افراد کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی حفاظت اور رحمت میں ہوتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: आयमुन
in_hindi.meaning: आयमुन का अर्थ है धन्य और सुरक्षित
in_hindi.long_meaning: आयमुन नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'أمن' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सुरक्षा और शांति। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम धन्य और सुरक्षित व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अल्लाह की सुरक्षा और आशीर्वाद में रहते हैं।

in_pashto.name: آيمينون
in_pashto.meaning: آيمينون معنی يې مبارک او خوندي دي

in_english.name: Aaymenun
in_english.meaning: Blessed and safe; one who is in divine protection
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aaymenun originates from the Arabic root 'أمن' (aman), meaning safety, security, and blessings. In Islamic tradition, Aaymenun signifies individuals who are blessed and protected by Allah. The name conveys a sense of divine guardianship and peace. Historically, names derived from 'أمن' have been used to express the wish for safety and prosperity. Aaymenun is a name that reflects spiritual significance and positive attributes.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Aaymenun" holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic community. The name is an Arabic word that means "one who supports and maintains the faith of Muslims." This name reflects the importance of community and mutual support in Islam. The name reminds us of the collective responsibility we have towards each other in maintaining the faith and preserving the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). In a practical sense, the name could signify a leader in the community or someone who goes above and beyond to help their fellow Muslims in times of need.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Aaymenun" is deeply rooted in the Islamic principle of Tawheed (Oneness of God). The name reminds us of our duty to uphold the faith of Allah (SWT) and to maintain the bond of brotherhood amongst Muslims. It highlights the importance of mutual support and encouragement towards one another in maintaining our relationship with Allah (SWT). The name "Aaymenun" teaches us that our faith is not just an individualistic pursuit but a collective one, and that we are all responsible for each other's spiritual growth. It also reminds us to seek Allah's help and support in fulfilling our spiritual and moral obligations.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Support of the faithful" symbolizes One who supports and maintains the faith of Muslims. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aaymenun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of support of the faithful.
